Du willst Ergebnisse, keine Diskussionen?
Du arbeitest strukturiert, hast ein klares Verständnis für saubere Prozesse und weißt, wie wichtig Verlässlichkeit im Vertrieb ist? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!
Wir suchen einen Senior Sales Consultant (m/w/d), der mit klarem Fokus auf Abschlussquote, Systemtreue und messbare Resultate arbeitet. In dieser Position übernimmst du Verantwortung für die direkte Kundengewinnung, führst strukturierte Verkaufsgespräche anhand erprobter Leitfäden und unterstützt beim Ausbau unserer Vertriebsprozesse. Visionen überlassen wir anderen, du bringst Klarheit, Kontrolle und Umsetzung.
Deine Aufgaben
Kundengewinnung mit Struktur: Gezielte Ansprache potenzieller Kunden, Bedarfsanalyse und Führung durch unseren klar definierten Vertriebsprozess.
Pflege stabiler Kundenbeziehungen: Saubere Betreuung mit nachvollziehbaren Abläufen, festen Schritten und dokumentierten Follow-ups.
Vertriebsprozesse umsetzen: Einhaltung von Standards, Arbeit mit KPIs und Sicherstellung, dass kein Schritt ausgelassen wird.
Teamverantwortung übernehmen: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team, klare Übergaben und Orientierung durch feste Strukturen.
Was wir dir bieten
Stabilität & Klarheit: Strukturierte Prozesse, feste Zuständigkeiten und ein durchdachtes Vertriebssystem.
Arbeitsplatz mit Planbarkeit: Geregelte Abläufe, messbare Ergebnisse und ein klarer Erwartungshorizont.
Büro in München: Konzentrationsfördernde Umgebung mit klarer Aufgabentrennung und ruhiger Atmosphäre.
Strukturiertes Onboarding: Systematische Einarbeitung, Schritt für Schritt.
Teamorientierte Umsetzung: Jeder kennt seinen Bereich, alles greift ineinander, ohne Reibungsverluste.
Mehrjährige Vertriebserfahrung, idealerweise im Beratungs- oder Agenturumfeld.
Freude an Zielen, Zahlen und dem sichtbaren Erfolg von klaren Abläufen.
Unternehmerisches Denken, strukturierte Umsetzung und eigenverantwortliches Handeln.
Klare Kommunikation in Deutsch und Englisch, sachlich, effizient, ohne Umwege.
Führung mit Struktur, nicht mit Vision, sondern mit System.

At Tribe Wellness, we're more than just a tribe – we're a movement. Rooted in courage, empowerment, and integrity, we've pioneered solutions that transform the world's wellness brands into revenue-generating machines. We bridge the gap between brands and revenue by turning our clients’ customers into lifetime supporters, and we do that by turning good salespeople into great salespeople.
At Tribe Wellness Sales, we’re on a mission to help pets live longer, healthier lives through supplements that actually deliver. But here’s the catch: too many pet owners grab a product online and then flounder—unsure how to use it or missing the guidance to make it work.

That’s where you, our Product Sales Specialist (called a Protocol Review Specialist in our world), make the difference. Without you, pets miss out on better health, owners lose confidence, and our mission stalls. With you? You’re the spark that turns a purchase into a transformation—for pets and their people.

Sell: You’ll sell products and services for our pet client, a company built for pet owners, by pet owners, with over a million happy dogs and growing!
Grow: Work with a broad range of potential customers, transforming clients’ prospects into brand loyalists.
Learn: Work closely with our dedicated leaders, leveraging our top-notch training resources to master the art of selling and representing Tribe's ethos.
Earn: Operate with no cap on commission, providing limitless earning potential to integrate with our operations seamlessly.
Live: Work from home in a global remote environment, utilizing our communication tools and platforms.

Earnings: This is a commission-only role. You will have between 8 and 18 appointments scheduled for you each day (more if you want them and you are closing sales). You will earn a 20% commission on the gross margin of every sale you make. Please tell us how much you want to earn, and we will show you what it takes to get there. Each sale is between $250 and $2,500.
The Tribe Tool Kit: We have a battle-tested tool kit we provide for all our sales consultants, including Rippling and Salesforce, ensuring you're primed for success the second you hit the phones.
Remote Work: You’ll have the freedom of a fully remote position, allowing for a work-life balance that suits your lifestyle.
Be Part of the Tribe: No matter your title, you’ll join a community that values partnership, advocacy, and growth. We believe in nurturing our team members and fostering an environment of collaboration, support, and mutual success.

Highly-driven self starters, who are motivated by growth opportunities and the drive to excel in sales.
Knowledge, background, or raw passion around health and wellness.
Excellent verbal and written skills, with top-notch communication skills and a knack for building genuine connections.
The ability to work 40 hours per week (8 hours per day) starting at 8 AM CST.
Reliable internet and equipment are required. Because this position involves frequent phone and video calls, you’ll need a setup that can support clear, uninterrupted conversations.

A fast and reliable laptop or desktop computer, with a working mic, camera, and a headset, so you can comfortably run our call system, Salesforce, and Zoom at the same time.
Ethernet connection strongly preferred because it provides the most consistent call quality. (Usually requires only an inexpensive cable you plug into your desktop/laptop and modem.)
Enough dedicated internet speed to support calls and video without freezing, delays, or dropped audio. Minimum [10] Mbps download / [5] Mbps upload of dedicated bandwidth, with latency under ~150ms, jitter under ~30ms, and packet loss under ~1% .
Join us if you’re ready to play a pivotal role in reshaping the world of pet health and wellness while thriving in a growth-centric global environment with amazing people. If that sounds like you, Tribe Wellness is your tribe. Apply today and work with a very different type of company.

QuickTeam helps US businesses grow by placing high-quality offshore talent — trained, vetted, and ready to work — at a fraction of the cost of hiring locally. We handle recruiting, onboarding, and client support from end to end. We're growing fast and looking for closers who want to be paid for what they actually produce. How this is different?

Most commission roles pay you once per deal and move on. This one keeps paying. Every month a client's virtual assistant is working, you earn. Close a client once, and that account generates income for as long as the VA stays — and our VAs typically stay for years. You're also not starting from scratch.

We have a dedicated lead specialist who continuously researches, qualifies, and contextualizes leads for you, so you're always working a warm pipeline. Your job is to close, not to build a list. What you get Warm, contextualized leads — a dedicated member of our team constantly builds and prepares your pipeline. You come in warm, not cold.

Recurring income — your commission is tied to hours billed by the VAs you place. Active placements mean monthly income, month after month, with no additional effort on your part. Long-term compounding upside — clients who stay for two or three years keep paying you the whole time. Your book of business grows and compounds.

Uncapped earnings in USD — no territory limits, no income ceiling. Full tools and access — CRM, dialer, email, and everything you need to work deals effectively. Backend handled for you — we manage recruiting, onboarding, and ongoing client delivery so you stay focused on selling.

What earnings look like Because commission is tied to hours worked rather than a flat placement fee, income compounds as your book grows. A modest base of a few active long-term clients generates meaningful recurring monthly income in USD — and that base keeps building as you close more.

The commission structure is competitive and discussed in full during the interview. How it works You apply and we walk you through the model, the leads, and the comp. We get you set up with tools and access. You start working leads and closing deals. You get paid — and keep getting paid every month your clients stay active.

Requirements What we're looking for Proven B2B sales or closing experience — staffing, services, SaaS, or similar preferred Exceptional spoken English is non-negotiable. This role is 100% phone-based selling to US business owners and decision makers.

Your voice, clarity, and confidence on a cold call is your product — if a prospect would hesitate for even a moment based on how you sound, this isn't the right fit. Candidates with a neutral, natural-sounding English accent are strongly preferred.

Comfortable working US EST/PST business hours Comfortable working leads by phone, email, and LinkedIn Self-motivated and disciplined — you don't need a manager over your shoulder Experience selling to or supporting US-based clients is a strong advantage Coachable, organized, and consistent in follow-up Hungry for uncapped, USD-denominated, performance-based income This role is not for Anyone expecting a base salary or guaranteed hourly pay People who need constant supervision or hand-holding Reps looking for a 9-to-5 with a predictable paycheck Originally posted on Himalayas

Act as the technical and solution expert supporting KAMs in pre‑sales, solution design and delivery of RFx responses for cloud and Telco Cloud opportunities.

Be solution responsible for cloud products in the GPEC area of responsibility, ensuring technical integrity, feasibility and alignment with Ericsson portfolio strategy.
Define and support solution and proposal strategies together with Customer Units (CUs) and cross‑functional presales and delivery teams.
Develop and present value propositions, business cases and TCO/ROI analyses that clearly articulate customer value and differentiation versus competitors.
Lead or contribute to customer workshops, demos and technical deep dives, adapting the communication to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
Share best practices, successful bid content and lessons learned across teams, and provide structured feedback to improve portfolio, processes and tools.
The skills you will bring
Strong experience in cloud solutions, with significant exposure to Telco Cloud and related technologies.
Proven background in technical presales, solution sales support or solution architecture, ideally within telecom, cloud infrastructure or adjacent industries.
Demonstrated experience owning and delivering high‑quality RFx/RFP responses in fast‑paced, customer‑facing environments.
Fluent technical English and Spanish.
Good understanding of core cloud concepts and Awareness of the competitive landscape in the cloud and Telco Cloud market and typical differentiators.
Strong value argumentation skills and the ability to build compelling, data‑driven business cases.
Proven ability to solve complex technical problems in multi‑vendor cloud/Telco Cloud environments.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex topics in a clear and structured way to diverse audiences.
Customer‑centric mindset, with the ability to build trust and long‑term relationships.
Collaborative team player who enjoys working across sales, technical and delivery teams in a global environment.
Enthusiastic, self‑driven and comfortable working under time pressure and tight RFx deadlines.
Passion for continuous learning in evolving cloud, automation and AI technologies.

Hands‑on experience with automation and AI in a cloud context.
Python scripting for automation, tooling or demos.
Exposure to Gen‑AI frameworks and how they can be used in presales, solution design or customer engagement.

The Sales Associate is responsible for providing all Marine Corps Exchange (MCX) customers with world class customer service with an additional emphasis on courtesy.

Sales associates are the primary service providers and will assist customers in every aspect of the retail business in a friendly, professional, and proactive manner that supports continued customer loyalty.

Sales associates assist their customers in challenging scenarios by using an "I can do that" mindset, to make all attempts for a positive customer experience and outcomes, before asking for support from the next level mentor or supervisor.

Sales associates are brand and customer program ambassadors for all Marine Corps and MCX programs, including but not limited to, Military Star, Super Star Student, customer satisfaction surveys and Keep it New.

This position can be scheduled throughout the facility, based on the needs of the business including but not limited to, cashier or self-checkout attendant, customer service, salesfloor / department support, stockroom / backroom, and military clothing.

In addition to working indoors, associates may be required to work outdoors or inside coolers and/or chillers. Limited time durations and proper Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) will be provided when working inside coolers and/or chillers.

Sales associates who are regularly scheduled in areas are expected to learn basic product knowledge to support customer satisfaction and service.

Sales associates perform store operations tasks such as but not limited to, customer and register transactions, Planogram revisions and setups, identifying missing products, replenish sales floor and coolers, setting promotional signage, visual merchandising, maintaining backroom standards through the 5S program and other operational tasks.

Light housekeeping tasks such as but not limited to, sweeping, dusting and trash removal may be part of daily assigned duties. Sales associates are supported by the Specialist role with mentoring, guidance, and training. Sales associates are expected to work with, learn from and request guidance from Specialists in addition to their supervisors.

Sales associates utilize and complete tasks with basic retail equipment including, but not limited to, cash registers, time clocks, RF scanners, mobile printers, handheld equipment (i.e., Price labeling units, box cutters), signage equipment and basic fixture equipment such as, but not limited to peg hooks, shelves, and mobile stocking carts (5S Program).

Assists in preparing and participates in year-end inventory and preparation. Identifies and communicates potential risk of loss and/or theft. May require additional training or certifications as required by the business and/or normal working assignments, including but not limited to, food safety training and fuel.

Articulates MCX value stories and engages with all team members through positive conversations and driving customer satisfaction in a teams win environment. Adheres to safety regulations and standards. Adheres to established standards of the EEO program and prevention of sexual harassment. Performs other duties as assigned.

This is a mixed position where the associate must be able to lift and carry objects up to 45 lbs. independently and objects over 45 lbs. with assistance. FOR POSITIONS AT GAS STATIONS ONLY: May assist with regular fuel lane maintenance including the handling and cleanup of hazardous materials or substances. Must wear appropriate PPE when required.

Must pass and maintain current fuel safety training as required.
At least 1 year experience working in a customer and sales-focused environment is preferred. Cash handling, basic math and register experience strongly preferred. Ability to read and understand operating standards and procedures for service, service recovery, sales and store brand and work within the position to execute these standards properly. Ability to work in a high-performance atmosphere with commitment to service and sales goals. Attention to detail is required.

## Das erwartet dich ##
In dieser vielseitigen Rolle bist du nahe am Verkauf, nahe an unseren Kundinnen und Kunden und ein wichtiger Dreh- und Angelpunkt im täglichen Geschäft. Du unterstützt unsere Versicherungs- und Vorsorgeberatenden aktiv und trägst mit deinem Engagement dazu bei, dass Kundenanliegen rasch verstanden und überzeugend gelöst werden.
## Das bewirkst du bei uns ##
Du bist mittendrin im Verkaufsgeschehen und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Versicherungs- und Vorsorgeberatenden optimal unterstützt werden.
Mit deinem Organisationstalent erstellst du Offerten, verarbeitest Anträge und koordinierst Termine über alle Versicherungsbranchen hinweg. Gleichzeitig bringst du dein verkäuferisches Flair aktiv ein: Du erkennst Kundenbedürfnisse, denkst mit und trägst dazu bei, dass aus Kontakten überzeugende Lösungen entstehen.
Ob am Telefon, am Empfang auf der Generalagentur oder im Austausch mit internen und externen Anspruchsgruppen: Du begegnest Menschen offen, dienstleistungsorientiert und mit Freude. So leistest du einen wichtigen Beitrag zu einem professionellen Kundenerlebnis und zum gemeinsamen Verkaufserfolg unserer Generalagentur.
## Das bringst du mit ##
* Eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, ergänzt durch den Versicherungsvermittler VBV oder den Versicherungsfachmann/-frau mit eidg. Fachausweis
* Fundierte Erfahrung in der Versicherungsbranche und kennstisse über Bedürfnisse von Kundinnen, Kunden und Vertriebspartnern
* Freude am direkten Kundenkontakt, insbesondere am Telefon sowie aufmerksame und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
* Vernetzte Denkweise, Dienstleistungsorientierung und bringst ein gutes Gespür für verkäuferische Chancen
* selbstständige und verantwortungsbewusste Arbeisweise und du bringst deine Ideen aktiv in den Verkaufsalltag ein
* Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse; weitere Sprachen sind ein Plus
## Bei uns arbeiten ##
In der Generalagentur Liestal erwartet dich ein lebendiges Team, das Zusammenarbeit, Nähe und Engagement im Alltag lebt. Mit 39 Mitarbeitenden, davon 2 Lernende, sowie einer eigenen Schadenabteilung vor Ort sind wir stark lokal verankert und für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden eine verlässliche Partnerin.
Mehr über unser Engagement als Arbeitgeberin findest du weiter unten.

Sind wir erfolgreich, profitieren auch unsere Mitarbeitenden. Jedes Jahr wird über die Ausschüttung einer Erfolgsbeteiligung und deren Höhe entschieden.

Wir bieten ein vielfältiges internes Kursangebot an. Bei jobrelevanten Weiterbildungen beteiligen wir uns.

## Was du bei uns bewegen kannst ##
* **Trainingsentwicklung:** Du erstellst technische Trainings zu neuen Modellen, Fahrzeug- und Hochvoltsystemen (Level 1S bis 3S) - didaktisch durchdacht und praxisnah
* **Training Delivery:** Du führst Trainings eigenständig in mindestens zwei Landessprachen durch - sowohl Basis- als auch Expertentrainings
* **Qualifizierungsprozess:** Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung von Kursunterlagen, der Trainingsplanung, den Ausschreibungen, bei Übersetzungen und wirkst bei markenspezifischen Zertifizierungen mit
* **Herstellerprogramme:** Du setzt die Qualifizierungsprogramme unserer Konzernmarken gemäss Vorgaben um

## Das bringst du mit ##
* **Erfahrung:** Du verfügst über mindestens sechs Jahre Berufserfahrung (inkl. Ausbildung) in der automobiltechnischen Welt und verfügst über die Kältemittelprüfung für Fahrzeugklimaanlagen
* **Fachchliche Qualifikation:** Du bringst eine automobiltechnische Grundausbildung mit, ergänzt durch eine höhere Fachausbildung wie z.B. Automobildiagnostiker\*in mit eidg. FA, Automobilingenieur\*in FH oder Master Technician auf unseren Konzernmarken. Eine methodisch-didaktische Weiterbildung oder ausgewiesene didaktische Erfahrung ist ein Plus
* **Digital Skills:** Du arbeitest routiniert mit den M365-Anwendungen - insbesondere PowerPoints, Word, und Teams
* **Sprachkenntnisse:** Du kommunizierst stilsicher auf Deutsch und bringst gute Französisch- und / oder Italienischkenntnisse auf mindestens B2-Niveau mit
* **Personality Fit:** Du überzeugst durch klare und offene Kommunikation, Freude am Unterrichten und ein hohes Mass an Empathie. Gleichzeitig arbeitest du selbstständig, strukturiert und zuverlässig - und behältst auch in vernetzten Situationen stets den Überblick. Als Teamplayer bringst du dich aktiv ein und trägst zur gemeinsamen Weiterentwicklung bei

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Online-Bewerbung. Übrigens: Ein Motivationsschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Nenne uns doch einfach drei überzeugende Gründe, wieso genau du die richtige Person für diese Stelle bist.
